faq: Any questions?
Do I need an account?
No. You can use Skinmetrics without signing up or logging in.
How does the skin analysis work?
Take a photo of your skin. With your permission, AI models analyse the photo and relevant profile details, which are sent through our relay service. You can then see the results in the app.
What does the skin score tell me?
The skin score summarises the AI's assessment of your skin. Individual metrics and your history help you compare results. The assessment can be inaccurate and isn't a medical measurement.
How do I take photos I can compare?
Try to use similar lighting, distance and angles each time. Avoid filters, harsh shadows and strong backlighting. Different conditions can affect the results.
Do I need an internet connection?
Yes, for a new AI analysis: your photo is sent through our relay service to AI models in the USA. Your saved history and routine are stored on your iPhone.
Where are my photos stored?
Your saved photo history stays on your iPhone. An iPhone backup may also include this app data. For AI analysis, a smaller copy of the photo is sent through our relay service to AI models.
What data is sent to the AI?
Along with the photo, relevant profile details are sent for the AI analysis. These may include skin type, skin goals, routine, and information about allergies or medical conditions.
More about privacy.
Does my data sync across devices?
There is currently no iCloud or CloudKit sync. An iPhone backup is different: it can back up your locally stored app data.
Can I export or delete my data?
You can delete your local data in the app's settings. Text export is a Premium feature. It includes scans, check-ins and routine data, but isn't a full photo export.
What can I do with my routine?
Organise your products and skincare steps for morning and evening, and tick off each step as you complete it.
Is this a medical diagnosis?
No. Skinmetrics helps you keep track of your skin. It doesn't replace medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
